verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is the product's runtime for agent-generated code, but it is documented as 'ephemeral', the opposite of persistent, and no snapshot or checkpoint feature is shown. Vercel Workflows offers durable multi-step application code that can resume across crashes. That is an adjacent building block for apps developers write, not a persistent coding-agent environment that checkpoints itself automatically.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can give my coding agent a persistent runtime environment that checkpoints its state automatically while working
